create_tokenizer_cpm_fast: create a CpmTokenizerFast instance from a SentencePiece vocab file and tokenizer JSON for CPM models
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build model inputs from a single sequence or pair of sequences by concatenating and adding special tokens for CPM
create_token_type_ids_from_sequences: create token type ID masks from one or two token sequences for CPM sequence-pair classification tasks
save_vocabulary_cpm_fast: save the CPM tokenizer vocabulary files to a specified directory with an optional filename prefix
encode_decode_cpm_fast: encode batch Chinese text using Jieba-RS segmentation and decode token IDs back to original text with CPM tokenizer
